presentation.summary: Control manual-handling risk when load characteristics, access and staffing change.
presentation.situation: A team must move awkward packaged components from a storage area to a workbench where access space is limited.
presentation.objective: Make five professional safety decisions as conditions change.
knownFacts: A team must move awkward packaged components from a storage area to a workbench where access space is limited.

work_authorization_record.title: Load and Route Assessment Record
work_authorization_record.summary: The team must move a heavy, awkward package through a narrow route with an uncertain center of gravity.
details: The load shape and unclear center of gravity can make grip forces and load movement difficult to predict.
The narrow travel path limits body position, turning space and opportunities to recover from an unstable load.
Weight, grip points, route constraints and mechanical-aid options should be understood before the lift begins.

control_verification_record.title: Mechanical Aid and Transfer Plan
control_verification_record.summary: A suitable lifting aid can handle most of the move, but the final placement still requires a short manual transfer.
details: The mechanical aid reduces the amount of manual handling but does not eliminate the final handling exposure.
The transfer point needs adequate space, coordinated grip positions and a clear destination for the load.
Team roles and communication are important because several people may need to move together during the final placement.

condition_change_record.title: Route Obstruction Change Record
condition_change_record.summary: Newly placed material has tightened the turn on the route that was originally assessed.
details: The planned movement path no longer provides the same turning clearance available during the initial assessment.
A tighter turn can increase twisting, reach and the chance of the load contacting an obstruction.
The route change invalidates the assumption that the original handling plan still fits the actual path.

response_record.title: Load Shift Event Record
response_record.summary: One worker lost grip and the package shifted unexpectedly during the transfer.
details: The unexpected shift shows that the load was not fully stable under the current grip and team arrangement.
Continuing immediately could expose workers to crush, strain or sudden-load hazards.
The event provides new information about grip, balance and coordination that should be addressed before another movement.

closeout_record.title: Post-Lift Handling Review
closeout_record.summary: The package is at the workbench and the team expects similar moves to occur again.
details: The completed move provides practical information about the load, route, transfer point and mechanical aid.
Any grip problem, obstruction or coordination difficulty should be captured before the task becomes routine.
Future moves should use the improved handling method rather than automatically repeat the first attempt.

safe_completion.title: Safe completion
safe_completion.narrative: The work is completed with controls verified.
safe_completion.keyTurningPoint: The key controls were verified before work continued.

controlled_recovery.title: Controlled recovery
controlled_recovery.narrative: Earlier gaps are recognized and corrected before completion.
controlled_recovery.keyTurningPoint: The team recovered by restoring the control boundary.

major_incident.title: Major incident
major_incident.narrative: Unresolved control gaps lead to a significant modeled outcome.
major_incident.keyTurningPoint: Work continued before the required controls were verified.
